description.en: The image ID of the AIC instance.

description.zh:
镜像类型，取值：

- **public**：公共镜像。

- **private**：自定义镜像。
description.en:
The type of the image. Valid values:

- **public**: public image

- **private**: custom image
The URL of the AIC image repository.

description.zh: 查询终止时间，格式"2006-01-02"；默认无时间限制。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the 2006-01-02 format. By default, the time range to query is not restricted.

description.zh: 查询起始时间，格式"2006-01-02"；默认无时间限制。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the 2006-01-02 format. By default, the time range to query is not restricted.
The page number. Pages start from page **1**. Default value: **1**.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值为**100**行。
默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is **100**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
镜像状态，取值：

- **verifying**：待认证

- **disable**：不可用。

- **available**：可用
description.en:
The status of the image. Valid values:

- **verifying**

- **disable**

- **available**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-aic-images --image-id m-ad0ddaddc2d54adeaa09b7c0f1e0000 --image-url 0000.alibaba-inc.com/aic/socimage:test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --status available --min-date 2022-01-02 --max-date 2022-02-02 --image-type public --description Console_test_operation --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DescribeAICImages --region cn-hangzhou --Status available --MaxDate '2022-02-02' --Description Console_test_operation --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --ImageId 'm-ad0ddaddc2d54adeaa09b7c0f1e0000' --ImageUrl '0000.alibaba-inc.com/aic/socimage:test' --MinDate '2022-01-02' --ImageType public
